name: codex-lfe
description: Safely configures canonical Codex Orchestration to use a Luna Max Fast executor.

interface.shortDescription: Configure Luna Max Fast execution safely.
interface.longDescription: CodexLFE checks the canonical Codex Orchestration dependency, creates a bounded Luna Max Fast custom executor, and manages the required machine-local Luna v2 compatibility shim with reversible state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run CodexLFE status and explain whether setup is needed.
